Models of class twdtw_knn1

Source: R/twdtw_knn1.R
predict.twdtw_knn1.Rd

Models created with version 1.0.0 of the package have the class twdtw_knn1. These methods classify and print them as models of class twdtw_knn, which is the class of the models created with this version. See plot.twdtw_knn for the plot.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'twdtw_knn1'
predict(object, newdata, ...)

# S3 method for class 'twdtw_knn1'
print(x, ...)

Arguments

object, x

A model of class twdtw_knn1.

newdata

The time series to classify: a three-dimensional stars object (x, y, time) with bands as attributes, or another form of time series of predict.twdtw_knn.

...

Arguments of the TWDTW distance that replace the arguments of the model, see predict.twdtw_knn. k cannot be used.

Value

predict() returns the result of predict.twdtw_knn: a stars object for a data cube, see twdtw_knn_predict.stars. print() returns the model, invisibly.

Details

predict() classifies with the nearest temporal pattern (k = 1), as version 1.0.0, and gives a message once per session, because this method will be deprecated in a future release. Create the model again with twdtw_knn to get a model of class twdtw_knn, which can be classified with other values of k.

The models of version 1.0.0 have a period in place of each hyphen of a band name, so the hyphens in the band names of newdata are replaced in the same way.

See also

twdtw_knn, twdtw_knn_predict.stars
